What GitHub runs on every pull request, so a reviewer sees the change by pile before reading a line of it.

What belongs here is each workflow, and what it asks of the actions it uses: arranging a change by pile, keeping the bot's comments up to date, and reviewing the change. How the blog itself is built or tested does not belong here, and each workflow runs only what the repository already says how to run.

Read this pile to find out what happens when a pull request is opened. Change it when a check is added to pull requests, or when one changes what it reports.
